title: Docs-sync map
description: AGENTS.md § Docs in sync, machine-readable. scripts/docs_sync.py parse_contract is the runtime validator; this file documents the same shape for editors.

ignore.description: Changed paths matching these never fire a rule (they may still satisfy one). Global false-positive control for tests, stories and lockfiles.

glob.description: Repo-relative glob, no leading `/` or `./`, no backslashes. `**` spans directories, `*` and `?` stay in one path segment, a trailing `/` matches the whole subtree below it.

id.description: Stable kebab id. Named in `Docs-Sync-Waive:` trailers, so renaming one orphans historical waivers.

when.description: AGENTS.md "When you change…" cell, trimmed; content otherwise verbatim (scripts/docs_sync.py render_table renders a compact table from it).

update.description: AGENTS.md "Update…" cell, trimmed; content otherwise verbatim. Every backticked token in it that resolves to a tracked repo path must be matched by a `docs` glob (scripts/docs_sync.py lint_contract).

docs.description: Paths that satisfy this rule. A change to any one of them, other than a path that itself fired the rule, satisfies it.

gate.description: Fails `docs_sync.py check` when fired, unsatisfied and unwaived.

advisory.description: Reports only, never fails the gate. `null` is a row with no code trigger yet (rendered in the table, never evaluated); an object gives it a trigger without gating on it.
